metadata.title: Studio Test
metadata.excerpt: I am publishing this test again

data.text:
The reason for publishing this test again is because, due to some technical problems i had to clear the browser data which led to the deletion of the stored old studio test.
However this test also clears that we can't rely blindly on the local storage. cloud persistence is the need of the hour.
Published directly from the Studio Publish button. 🔥
